bio.summary: Passionate software engineer with 4 years of experience building scalable web applications. I specialize in React, Node.js, and cloud technologies, with a proven track record of delivering high-quality solutions that drive business growth.
bio.longDescription: I'm a dedicated software engineer who thrives on solving complex problems and building innovative solutions. My journey in tech began during my computer science studies, where I discovered my passion for full-stack development. Over the past 4 years, I've worked on diverse projects ranging from enterprise applications to modern web platforms, always focusing on clean code, user experience, and scalable architecture.

projects.title: E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: Full-stack e-commerce solution with payment processing, inventory management, and admin dashboard. Built for scalability with microservices architecture.
projects.longDescription: A comprehensive e-commerce platform designed for modern retail needs. Features include real-time inventory tracking, secure payment processing via Stripe, order management system, and responsive design. The platform handles thousands of concurrent users and processes hundreds of orders daily.

projects.title: Task Management App
projects.description: Collaborative task management application with real-time updates, team workspaces, and advanced filtering. Designed for remote teams.
projects.longDescription: A modern task management solution that helps teams stay organized and productive. Features include drag-and-drop task boards, real-time collaboration, deadline tracking, file attachments, and comprehensive reporting. Built with performance and user experience in mind.

projects.title: Weather Dashboard
projects.description: Interactive weather dashboard with location-based forecasts, historical data visualization, and mobile-responsive design.
projects.longDescription: A comprehensive weather application that provides detailed forecasts, historical weather patterns, and interactive maps. Users can track multiple locations, receive weather alerts, and view detailed analytics about weather trends.

projects.title: API Gateway Service

projects.longDescription: A robust API gateway solution designed to handle enterprise-level traffic. Includes features like JWT authentication, rate limiting, request/response transformation, monitoring, and analytics. Supports multiple backend services with intelligent load balancing.
